subproblems.title: A representation of a sum of two IMRep actions has the summed vector density
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) and R = (M, θ, ξ) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n, Simon Ch. 6, 3.1), and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n). Write τ(R')(ω) := R'.action ω = ∫_{M'} θ'(x)ξ'(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume R represents T (T(ω) = τ(R)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U)) and T(ω) = τ(R₁)(ω) + τ(R₂)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P the n-vectors in MultiVector P n satisfy 1_M(x)θ(x)ξ(x) = 1_{M₁}(x)θ₁(x)ξ₁(x) + 1_{M₂}(x)θ₂(x)ξ₂(x) (written with Set.indicator and real scalar multiplication).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = R₁.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + R₂.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 1 of the parent-supplied proof of the selected node. That step is the vector-measure identity behind the competitor mass bound in Simon's proof of 7.2.4, (8)–(9) (chapter-07.txt lines 222–246), for Y = Z + X. The three accepted siblings comb_exists, comb_action and density_unique are used exactly as in that step, and the a.e. bookkeeping of its part (d) is written out.
Notation. H := μHE[n]. For an IMRep R' = (M', θ', ξ') in U put ν_{R'}(x) := 1_{M'}(x)θ'(x)ξ'(x) ∈ MultiVector P n, i.e. ν_{R'} = M'.indicator (y ↦ (θ'(y) : ℝ) • ξ'(y)), and τ(R')(ω) := R'.action ω = ∫_{M'} θ'(x)ξ'(x)(ω(x)) dH(x). Write R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂), R = (M, θ, ξ).
1. A combination representative. Apply the sibling comb_exists (Submission.rsdic_exists_imrep_int_combination) to U (open), R₁, R₂ and the integers p₁ = p₂ = 1. It gives an IMRep R' = (M', θ', ξ') in U with ν_{R'}(x) = ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ)•ν_{R₁}(x) + ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ)•ν_{R₂}(x) = ν_{R₁}(x) + ν_{R₂}(x) for H-a.e. x.
2. R' represents T. Fix ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Apply the sibling comb_action (Submission.rsdic_imrep_action_int_combination) to R₁, R₂, R', p₁ = p₂ = 1 and the a.e. identity of step 1: τ(R')(ω) = 1·τ(R₁)(ω) + 1·τ(R₂)(ω) = τ(R₁)(ω) + τ(R₂)(ω). By hypothesis the right side equals T(ω). Hence T(ω) = R'.action ω for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), i.e. R'.Represents T.
3. Agreement on the carriers. R' and R both represent T, and U is open. The sibling density_unique (Submission.imrep_weighted_orient_indicator_ae_eq), applied to T, R' and R, gives ν_{R'}(x) = ν_R(x) for H⌞(M' ∪ M)-a.e. x. Each carrier is measurable (measurableSet_carrier), so M' ∪ M is measurable. The statement is therefore equivalent to: for H-a.e. x, x ∈ M' ∪ M ⟹ ν_{R'}(x) = ν_R(x) (Mathlib ae_restrict_iff').
4. Agreement off the carriers. If x ∉ M' ∪ M, then x ∉ M' and x ∉ M. An indicator vanishes off its set, so ν_{R'}(x) = 0 = ν_R(x).
5. Conclusion. The points x where both the implication of step 3 and the identity of step 1 hold form an H-conull set (the intersection of two H-conull sets). At such an x, steps 3–4 give ν_R(x) = ν_{R'}(x), whether or not x ∈ M' ∪ M. Step 1 gives ν_{R'}(x) = ν_{R₁}(x) + ν_{R₂}(x). Hence ν_R(x) = ν_{R₁}(x) + ν_{R₂}(x) for H-a.e. x, which is the assertion. ∎

subproblems.title: The a.e. identity ν_R = ν_{R₁} + ν_{R₂} integrates against bounded compactly supported covector fields
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, K ⊆ ℝ^P with K compact and K ⊆ U, let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) and R = (M, θ, ξ) be IMReps in U (IMRep U n), and let B ∈ ℝ. Let F : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n (n-covectors on ℝ^P) be a.e.-strongly measurable for Hⁿ = μHE[n], with F(x) = 0 for every x ∉ K and ‖F(x)‖ ≤ B for every x (operator norm). Suppose that 1_M(x)θ(x)ξ(x) = 1_{M₁}(x)θ₁(x)ξ₁(x) + 1_{M₂}(x)θ₂(x)ξ₂(x) in MultiVector P n for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P. Then ∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(F(x)) dHⁿ(x) = ∫_{M₁} θ₁(x)ξ₁(x)(F(x)) dHⁿ(x) + ∫_{M₂} θ₂(x)ξ₂(x)(F(x)) dHⁿ(x).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (F : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (B : ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable F μHE[n] → (∀ x, x ∉ K → F x = 0) → (∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x) → ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n] = ∫ x in R₁.carrier, (R₁.mult x : ℝ) * R₁.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n] + ∫ x in R₂.carrier, (R₂.mult x : ℝ) * R₂.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n]

Source: steps 3 and 6 of the parent-supplied proof of the selected node, S(ω) = ∫ (ν_Z + ν_X)(φ) dHⁿ = ∫ ν_Y(φ) dHⁿ with every integrand dominated on the compact closure of G. The argument is step 4 of the accepted sibling comb_action with the test form ω replaced by a bounded, compactly supported field F. Integrability on each carrier comes from the accepted sibling pairing_bound.
Notation. H := μHE[n]. For an IMRep R' = (M', θ', ξ') in U put ν_{R'} := M'.indicator (y ↦ (θ'(y) : ℝ) • ξ'(y)) : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n, h_{R'}(x) := θ'(x)·ξ'(x)(F(x)) ∈ ℝ, and I(R') := ∫_{M'} h_{R'} dH = ∫ h_{R'} d(H⌞M'). The claim is I(R) = I(R₁) + I(R₂).
1. Integrability on each carrier. Let R' = (M', θ', ξ') be any IMRep in U. F is a.e.-strongly measurable for H, hence for the restriction H⌞M' (Mathlib AEStronglyMeasurable.restrict). Apply the sibling pairing_bound (Submission.dpf_pfc_imrep_pairing_integrable_abs_le) with C := K (compact, K ⊆ U), the field F (F = 0 off K and ‖F‖ ≤ B) and the bound B. Its first conjunct says that h_{R'} is H⌞M'-integrable.
2. Pointwise rewriting. For every x, ν_{R'}(x)(F(x)) = 1_{M'}(x)·h_{R'}(x). If x ∈ M', then ν_{R'}(x) = θ'(x)•ξ'(x) and (θ'(x)•ξ'(x))(F(x)) = θ'(x)·ξ'(x)(F(x)) = h_{R'}(x). If x ∉ M', then ν_{R'}(x) = 0 and 0(F(x)) = 0.
3. Global form. M' is measurable (measurableSet_carrier). By step 2, x ↦ ν_{R'}(x)(F(x)) is the indicator of M' applied to h_{R'}. By Mathlib integrable_indicator_iff and step 1 it is H-integrable, and by Mathlib integral_indicator ∫ ν_{R'}(x)(F(x)) dH(x) = ∫_{M'} h_{R'} dH = I(R').
4. The hypothesis evaluated at F. For H-a.e. x, ν_R(x) = ν_{R₁}(x) + ν_{R₂}(x) as continuous linear maps on n-covectors. A sum of linear maps is evaluated termwise, so ν_R(x)(F(x)) = ν_{R₁}(x)(F(x)) + ν_{R₂}(x)(F(x)) for H-a.e. x.
5. Conclusion. Apply step 3 to R, R₁ and R₂. A.e.-equal functions have equal Bochner integrals (step 4), and the integral is additive on the H-integrable functions x ↦ ν_{R_i}(x)(F(x)) (step 3). Hence
I(R) = ∫ ν_R(F) dH = ∫ (ν_{R₁}(F) + ν_{R₂}(F)) dH = ∫ ν_{R₁}(F) dH + ∫ ν_{R₂}(F) dH = I(R₁) + I(R₂).
This is the asserted identity ∫_M θξ(F) dHⁿ = ∫_{M₁} θ₁ξ₁(F) dHⁿ + ∫_{M₂} θ₂ξ₂(F) dHⁿ. ∎

subproblems.title: The pull-back of a bounded continuous form along a C¹ map, cut off to G, is measurable and bounded by WΛⁿ
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let G, O ⊆ ℝ^P be open with G ⊆ O, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be of class C¹ on O, let ω : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n (a DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) be continuous with ‖ω(z)‖ ≤ W for every z (operator norm on n-covectors), and let Λ ≥ 0 with ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ Λ for every x ∈ G (Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x, operator norm). Let φ := 1_G·(x ↦ ω(f(x))∘Df(x)), i.e. φ(x) = (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x) for x ∈ G and φ(x) = 0 for x ∉ G.
